description: A labeled dataset for building HVAC systems operating in faulted and fault-free states is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jessica Granderson et al. Open data is fueling innovation across many fields. In the domain of building science, datasets that can be used to inform the development of operational applications - for example new control algorithms and performance analysis methods - are extremely difficult to come by. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2023. Formats: CSV. The data are held in DOE Open Energy Data Initiative (OEDI); Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 5 files. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
